d: Aagami 21 navanbar ko pradhanmantri narendr modi ke prastavit bihar daure aur kachchi dargah-bidupur chhah len pul ka nam 'nitish setu' rakhe jane ko lekar chal rahe rajnitik vivad ke bich rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ki sansad misa bharti ka bayan samne aaya hai. midiya se batchit karte hue sansad misa bharti ne is namakran ko lekar bhartiy janta parti (BJP) aur dabal injan ki sarkar par tikha hamla bola hai. "hindu aur sanatan dharm men jivit rahte kisi ke nam par pul ya mandir nahin rakha jata":apne bayan men RJD sansad misa bharti ne kaha ki do sal ke bad is dabal injan ki sarkar ko…
